patch_description:
A drastically parameter-efficient, symmetry-exploiting ansatz that replaces the previous hub-variance with a single shared hub parameter across center-edge interactions and a ring of shared CRX entanglers around the tic-tac-toe perimeter. This keeps the per-block parameter count to 11 (vs 60/66 in earlier variants) while maintaining expressive power through data re-uploading. The design uses:
- pre/post single-qubit RZ layers with symmetry sharing (rz_pre_* / rz_post_*)
- global RY layers with symmetry sharing (ry_*)
- a ring CRX entangler with a single shared parameter crx_ring across the perimeter
- a hub entangler with a single shared parameter hub_shared across four center-edge gates
This combination yields improved generalization and competitive accuracy with fewer parameters, aligning with the optimization objective while preserving the same inputs/outputs.
